name: Codespace with PowerShell, Pester, Invoke-Build, and .NET 9
postCreateCommand: pwsh -Command 'sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get remove cmdtest; sudo apt-get install yarnpkg; sudo ln -s /bin/yarnpkg /bin/yarn; Install-Module -Name InvokeBuild,Pester -Force -SkipPublisherCheck; sleep 5; Invoke-Build Build   '
